title: Only three copies remain

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
DP reachability; a bitmask names a subset; base-10 digits.
doesNotKnow: Enforce a finite copy limit with bounded-choice transitions.

misconception: A reusable-item DP can enforce inventory merely by tracking total capacity.
objective: Enforce a finite copy limit with bounded-choice transitions.

claims.text: Each transition reads the previous item row and enumerates only the allowed copy count. Capacity alone cannot enforce stock: the separate copy bound excludes otherwise feasible combinations.
